title: Stuck watch never reads durable storage activity (durableResume gets full argv)
body:
activityWatch.look and lastRunnerEvent call durableResume(record.Runner, record.RunnerArgv). But executor.go stores the RESOLVED argv in record.RunnerArgv, which is never empty, so durableResume always returns false in the supervisor. The durable runner's conversation storage mtime (tick bgx) is therefore never read as activity, and the evidence says 'no session transcript could be read'. A durable worker in a long, quiet model generation is judged only on tool CPU, worktree and branch, so it can be nudged and stopped while it is working.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/activity.go:353 and :696; executor.go:444 (record.RunnerArgv = argv); the runner log of TestAStuckDurableWorkerInAHungToolIsSteeredThroughIt reads 'no session transcript could be read' for the pi runner
